requirements.text: take the alert ticket about Palo Alto Networks PA-3220 at our headquarters in the UK's capital and raise it one notch below the top
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_case WHERE case_id = 184 AND priority = 'high'
assumptions: the alert ticket is CS-0000184 (case 184): the only alert-channel Stark Industries case on a PA-3220 product, whose installed product 42 sits at Stark Industries Hq - London (location 817)
one notch below the top of the priority list (critical, high, moderate, low) is high

requirements.text: Move it off the vendor liaison desk to your first second-line specialists of csm support
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_case WHERE case_id = 184 AND assignment_group_id = 2
assumptions: the vendor liaison desk is the case's current group, Vendor Case Liaison_3 (52)
first second-line specialists of csm support is CSM Tier 2 Support (2), the first of the four CSM Tier 2 Support groups (2, 22, 42, 62)

requirements.text: Set Tonya Stevens as our poc on this ticket
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_case WHERE case_id = 184 AND contact_id = 11
assumptions: Tonya Stevens is portal user 287, whose contact record on Stark Industries is contact 11; the case's current contact is 10

requirements.text: Switch the response target to high with no pause and restart its clock
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM case_sla WHERE case_sla_id = 2465 AND case_id = 184 AND sla_def_id = 11 AND stage = 'in_progress' AND start_time IS NOT NULL
assumptions: id assumed next in sequence; the only case_sla tool links a new row, so the switch creates exactly one row
high response with no pause is SLA Response - High (No Pause), sla_def_id 11
a restarted clock is a new link whose timer is running (stage in_progress) with a recorded start time; the start time's value is not fixed

cells.short_description: Product: Palo Alto Networks PA-3220 Variant 8, Issue: is not working as expected.

requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_case WHERE case_id = 184 AND short_description = 'Product: Palo Alto Networks PA-3220 Variant 8, Issue: is not working as expected.'
assumptions: short_description is the case's only title or description column, which must keep its seed text

requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_case WHERE case_id = 184 AND state <> 'closed'
assumptions: the request forbids closing only; the case is in_progress on the seed and other state moves are not fixed by the request

requirements.text: the alert ticket about Palo Alto Networks PA-3220
requirements.selector: account_id = 8 AND product_id IN (128, 140, 152, 164, 176) AND case_id <> 184
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_case WHERE account_id = 8 AND product_id IN (128, 140, 152, 164, 176) AND case_id <> 184 AND assignment_group_id = 2
assumptions: boundary of the case description: the six other Stark Industries cases on PA-3220 products (181, 189, 193, 194, 200 on the same London HQ unit, 195 on Variant 32 with no installed product; none on channel alert) must not be moved to CSM Tier 2 Support

disagreement: selector: A account_id = 8 AND product_id IN (128, 140, 152, 164, 176) AND case_id <> 184 (six rows), B account_id = 8 AND installed_product_id = 42 AND case_id <> 184 (five rows); chose A's because it is the tighter boundary of the same description: it holds every row of B's and also guards case 195, a Stark Industries PA-3220 case a loose reading of 'the ticket about Palo Alto Networks PA-3220' would sweep in

notes:
disagreement: value: the selector of the stay on the other PA-3220 cases: one pass all six other Stark Industries cases on any PA-3220 product, the other the five other cases on the headquarters unit (installed product 42); chose the six, which hold every row of the five and also guard case 195, a PA-3220 case a loose reading of the description would sweep in. The requirement texts and assumptions otherwise differ in wording only.
The case's existing response SLA row 367 (SLA Response - Moderate, paused) is not tested: the request asks for the response target to be switched, which the new link does, and no listed tool updates or cancels an existing case SLA. The resolution SLA (row 368) is outside the request. The new SLA row's start time is tested only as present, because its value is set when the agent acts; the new SLA definition applies to high priority, which matches the raised priority.
The acting user, Tonya Stevens, is a Stark Industries customer portal user; the policy has the assistant act with admin responsibilities by default, so the reassignment, contact change and SLA link are within policy and no requirement depends on her role.
